column1: # Real names whose epithet is on blacklist-epithets.txt ("Caryota no", "Hypanus say") or is the
# indet marker "spec" ("Trichosternus spec", which stays a species without its author). A listed name
# is not flagged doubtful, and a listed epithet that is also an author particle ("du", "das", "los")
# is read as the epithet ("Sympycnus du Curran, 1929"), not as part of the author.
# See resources/README.md for how the list was built and how to extend it.
# Columns, tab-separated: epithet, genus, original author (the basionym author when bracketed, else
# the author), and the name as found, for review only. A name matches a line when its epithet does
# and either its genus or its original author does: the author carries a line across recombinations
# ("Raja say Lesueur" covers "Hypanus say (Lesueur, 1817)"). Genus and epithet are matched without
# case, the author on its surname without case or accents.
